title: Secret Maneuvering
next_chapter_hook: After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stared at the Jade Pendant in his hand, vaguely sensing an indescribable aura sealed within—this seemingly ordinary token was far from simple on the surface.

text.content:
Tianqing Sect, Servants' Slope.

As twilight fell, Chen Ji sat on the threshold of a dilapidated wooden hut, his fingers unconsciously rubbing a broken bamboo slip. The seventh page of the Tianji Record pulsed faintly in his Mental Sea—the afterglow of foresight's end, and a warning of Heavenly Fate's depletion.

The turmoil of the Sect Competition had yet to settle. He clearly remembered when he, as a 'trash', defeated several Inner Disciples in succession—the expressions of those elders on the high platform—some sneering, some indifferent, but there were also a few gazes carrying depths he couldn't decipher.

【Eyes in the Shadows】

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes and spread his divine sense outward. The night wind on the Servants' Slope carried the scent of rotting vegetation, and occasionally from afar came the footsteps of night patrol disciples changing shifts. Everything seemed normal.

But his intuition was screaming warnings.

That feeling of being watched had haunted him since the end of the Sect Competition. Like an eye hidden in some corner beyond his perception, watching his every move relentlessly, day and night.

dialogue.content:
"Boy, did you sense it?"

The voice of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul echoed in his Mental Sea, carrying a languid playfulness. "For someone at your cultivation level to detect surveillance, your perception is stronger than I anticipated."

Chen Ji offered no response, merely maintaining that posture, appearing as utterly lifeless as a truetrash.

text.content:
【Traces of the Watcher】

After a moment, Chen Ji rose to his feet, hunched over, leaning on a crooked wooden staff, and slowly made his way toward the Rear Mountain. He walked very slowly, breathing heavily, his footsteps echoing distinctly in the night.

But his divine sense remained unfurled like an invisible net, capturing everything around him.

The watcher was cautious, concealed atop an ancient pine three hundred zhang away, suppressing their aura almost to the point of nonexistence. Had Chen Ji not deliberately paused moments ago to let the other relax their guard, he could never have locked onto that person's location.

dialogue.content:
(Three hundred zhang away, using aura suppression to hide—at least Foundation Building late stage cultivation.)

Chen Ji recited silently in his heart, a smile tugging at the corner of his lips, invisible to others.

(Interesting. The sect's upper echelons truly think highly of thistrash, actually dispatching Foundation Building late stage to monitor me.)

text.content:
He didn't stir the snake.

In the Rear Mountain there was an abandoned spiritual spring, completely ignored in daily life. Chen Ji pretended to go there for water, actually sitting by the spring for half an hour, firmly memorizing the watcher's position, cultivation level, and even their spiritual energy fluctuation characteristics.

Then, as if nothing had happened, he slowly walked back.

【Uninvited Guest】

The next morning.

The moment Chen Ji pushed open his wooden door, he saw a cold figure standing not far in front of him. White robes as pure as snow, long hair like a cascading waterfall, the cold aura between her brows so sharp no one dared meet her gaze directly.

Su Qingyao.

Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the foremost prodigy of Tianqing Sect's younger generation. She stood there quietly, her gaze fixed on Chen Ji, fathomless.

dialogue.content:
"Junior Brother Chen."

Su Qingyao spoke, her voice like ice-cold spring water striking stone—cold yet carrying a hint of distance. "Did you rest well last night?"

Chen Ji slightly bowed, presenting an expression of utter panic: "Reply to Senior Sister Su, the disciple is well. May I know what brings Senior Sister to grace this place?"

He kept his head bowed, posture so humble as to be flawless.

text.content:
Su Qingyao didn't answer immediately. She simply watched him quietly. That gaze was like wanting to see through his entire being, yet always separated by an invisible barrier.

This was already the third time she had 'accidentally' appeared before Chen Ji.

The first was the Outer Disciple gathering before the Sect Competition, the second was after the competition ended when everyone dispersed, and the third—right now, at the Servants' Slope where she had no business being.

Coincidence?

Chen Ji never believed in coincidences.

dialogue.content:
"After the Sect Competition, several seniors have been quite concerned about you."

Su Qingyao's voice suddenly dropped lower. "Junior Brother Chen, I came today to warn you—some people's concern for you does not stem from goodwill."

She paused, as if weighing her words: "If you're a wise person, you should know how to protect yourself."

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his head, revealing an expression of perfectly fitting confusion: "Senior Sister Su, the disciple doesn't understand what you're implying. The disciple is merely a menial servant, what merit could possibly attract the seniors' concern?"

Su Qingyao's eyes flickered slightly.

She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, seemingly wanting to find some flaw. But on that face so ordinary it couldn't be more ordinary, there was only confusion and unease.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao took the initiative to show kindness. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Pretend to be overwhelmed with gratitude
choices.description: Accept this 'kindness' in the posture of atrash, secretly observing Su Qingyao's true intentions.

text.content:
Chen Ji dropped to his knees with a thud, voice trembling: "Senior Sister Su, why... why would you tell me this? What merit do I have..."

He performed so convincingly that even his eye sockets slightly reddened. Su Qingyao's gaze flickered with complex emotions, seemingly hesitating about something.

dialogue.content:
"Get up."

Su Qingyao slightly furrowed her brow, her tone gaining a hint of helplessness. "I don't like people kneeling to me. You... get up and speak properly."

She seemed caught off guard by thistrash Junior Brother's excessive reaction.

choices.text: Test what inside information she knows
choices.description: Advance by retreating, subtly probe how much intelligence Su Qingyao actually possesses about himself.

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly stood up, the panic on his face subtly receding. He kept his head bowed, voice low: "Senior Sister Su mentioned 'concern'—may I ask specifically which seniors? The disciple is dull-witted, please clarify, Senior Sister."

Su Qingyao's gaze suddenly turned sharp.

dialogue.content:
"You were just playing dumb moments ago, yet now you're asking who specifically?"

Su Qingyao's voice cooled several degrees. "Chen Ji, you truly are not simple."

choices.description: Use the inferiority complex of atrash as an excuse to refuse Su Qingyao's goodwill, avoiding getting too close to her.
choices.risk_hint: May offend the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow

text.content:
Chen Ji took a step backward, deeply bowing his head: "Senior Sister Su, the disciple knows his low status and doesn't dare have too much contact with Senior Sister. The disciple accepts your kindness in his heart..."

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even tighter, the scrutiny in her gaze becoming increasingly obvious.

dialogue.content:
"You..."

Su Qingyao seemed to want to say something, but ultimately swallowed her words. She stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly produced a Jade Pendant from her sleeve and extended it toward him: "Forget it. Keep this Jade Pendant. If you encounter urgent danger, crush it—I can sense it."

text.content:
【The Secret of the Jade Pendant】

Su Qingyao placed the Jade Pendant in Chen Ji's hand, then turned to leave. Her pace was quick, as if not wanting to stay here another moment.

Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at the Jade Pendant in his palm, his expression intrigued.

This was a superior quality mutton-fat jade, warm and smooth throughout, faintly glowing with a pale green sheen. Just this Jade Pendant's material alone was worth ten years of a Servant Disciple's allowance.

What the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow casually gave away was indeed extraordinary.

dialogue.content:
"Boy, this Jade Pendant is strange."

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea again, this time carrying a hint of gravity. "It seals within a strand of... even this old man cannot see through its nature. This thing is probably far more than just a communication artifact."

Chen Ji said nothing, merely tucking the Jade Pendant into his chest, then turned back into the wooden hut.

text.content:
【Undercurrents】

Returning inside, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the dilapidated bed, slowly probing his divine sense into the Jade Pendant.

In an instant, a cool aura rushed upward along his divine sense. That aura was gentle yet carrying a hint of sharpness, like a soft sword hidden in velvet—attempting to probe his Mental Sea the moment of contact.

Chen Ji sharply withdrew his divine sense, his brow locking tight.

dialogue.content:
(What a sophisticated divine sense imprint.)

Chen Ji coldly smirked in his heart. Su Qingyao giving this Jade Pendant was probably not simply to 'protect' him. The exquisite nature of that aura far exceeded what Foundation Building cultivators could arrange.

Within this Jade Pendant might be hidden not just an insurance policy—but a surveillance window.

(Interesting. Su Qingyao, which side are you really on?)

text.content:
【The Beginning of the Maneuver】

Night fell.

Unlike usual, Chen Ji did not go to sleep early. Instead, he donned a gray cloak and quietly departed the Servants' Slope.

His figure flickered in the moonlight like a wandering spirit, silently passing through layers of buildings, finally arriving at a dense forest in the sect's Rear Mountain.

The cultivator monitoring him was still at their post tonight.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji hid behind a massive boulder, suppressing his aura to the extreme. His gaze pierced through layers of branches, falling upon that ancient pine three hundred zhang away.

In the moonlight, he finally clearly saw the watcher's face—an elderly man with a withered complexion, wearing Tianqing Sect's steward attire, eyes closed in meditation.

(Someone from the Outer Court Steward's Office.)

Chen Ji silently noted this detail. The Outer Court Steward's Office nominally managed all affairs of Servant Disciples, but in reality—that place was directly under the influence of Ling Yuan's Old Sect Master.

choice.prompt: The watcher has been exposed. How should Chen Ji counter?

choices.description: Deliberately let them discover that he knows he's being monitored, then as atrash go to the Steward's Office to 'seek help,'顺势 probing Ling Yuan's layout.

text.content:
The corner of Chen Ji's mouth curved upward, his figure flickering as he deliberately stepped out from behind the boulder, snapping a withered branch beneath his foot.

The elderly watcher instantly opened his eyes, his gaze like lightning shooting toward where Chen Ji had been.

But Chen Ji had already resumed that hunchbacked, timid appearance, walking slowly forward as if just a lost Servant Disciple wandering at night.

dialogue.content:
(Good, you saw me.)

Chen Ji recited silently in his heart. (Then let's see if you'll report this to Ling Yuan.)

choices.description: Continue feigning ignorance, surviving in the posture of atrash while secretly recording the watcher's patterns and weaknesses.

text.content:
Chen Ji gathered his thoughts and turned to leave quietly. He didn't stir the snake, but continued acting as atrash moving about the sect.

But in his mind, he had already begun constructing an intelligence network—the watcher's shift changes, movement patterns, even possible weaknesses—all were recorded by him one by one.

dialogue.content:
"The young one is teachable."

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of praise. "A true hunter never reveals his fangs before his prey."

text.content:
【An Unexpected Discovery】

Just as Chen Ji prepared to leave, a subtle spiritual energy fluctuation came from the distance. He paused mid-step, his gaze following that fluctuation—the direction of the sect's Council Hall.

Late at night, someone was still deliberating in the Council Hall? And that spiritual energy fluctuation... at least three strands, each exuding a chilling pressure.

That was the aura only Core Formation cultivators possessed!

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart.

Three Core Formation cultivators deliberating in secret at night—this could never be ordinary. Although his cultivation was weak, with the Tianji Record Fragment's perception, he vaguely caught a sense of inauspiciousness.

Those people seemed to be discussing something related to him.

(So it seems this 'trash' has been placed on the chessboard by someone.)

choice.prompt: The abnormal activity in the Council Hall late at night. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to foresee what might occur in the Council Hall over the next three hours.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, sinking his divine sense into his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled before his eyes, golden characters dancing like dragons.

Three breaths later, he opened his eyes, his complexion slightly pale.

The foresight was blurry—because the existence of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' was interfering with heavenly secrets. But even so, he captured several key pieces of information: Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master, and... a cage covered with red cloth.

dialogue.content:
(A cage... what method will they use to deal with me?)

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, firmly memorizing this image. Heavenly Fate had already been consumed by 5 points, but he had obtained crucial clues.

This trade was worth it.

choices.description: Don't lightly consume Heavenly Fate, but continue lurking, attempting to gather more on-site intelligence.
choices.risk_hint: Core Formation cultivators have extremely strong perception

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed his aura, quietly approaching the direction of the Council Hall. His form pressed extremely low, every step calculated for the landing point, avoiding possible alert formations.

However, the moment he drew within a hundred zhang, a sharp spiritual sense swept over him like a blade.

His heart lurched; he quickly flattened himself against the ground, pretending to be an ordinary boulder.

dialogue.content:
(Too close... one step more and I would have been discovered.)

Cold sweat beaded on Chen Ji's forehead. Although he hadn't obtained specific intelligence, he had confirmed at least one thing—the secret deliberations in the Council Hall were definitely connected to him.

That was enough.

text.content:
【The Return Journey】

Chen Ji quietly returned to the Servants' Slope, sorting through tonight's discoveries one by one.

Ling Yuan's people were already monitoring him; the Jade Pendant from Su Qingyao concealed hidden mechanisms; three Core Formation cultivators in the Council Hall were deliberating in secret, likely related to him.

On the surface, he was atrash disciple being 'concerned' by the sect's upper echelons. But in reality, he had already stood at the heart of the storm.

(The good show is just beginning.)
